description: Full text of ONE page in the Caper knowledge base. Address it by `path` ("dao-governance/concepts/voting/quadratic-voting" – exactly the `path` field the listing tools return), or by `tagPath` + `slug`. Use this only for a single known page: for 2 to 20 pages call get_pages instead, which is one round trip rather than N. Pass the path, not a page title. A miss returns near-match slugs so a wrong guess is recoverable in one retry.

path.description: Full page path, e.g. "governance/voting". Preferred over tagPath+slug.

slug.description: Page slug, e.g. "voting". Ignored when `path` is set.

tagPath.description: Tag path only, e.g. "governance" ("" for a top-level page). Ignored when `path` is set.

name: get_page
title: Read a page
